literal_meaning: অভিপ্রায় বা ইচ্ছার প্রকাশ (আরবি উদ্ভবের শব্দ)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজের জন্য আমার কোনো ইরাদা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: I have no intention of doing this job.
history: The word 'ইরাদা' originates from Arabic 'irāda', introduced to Bengali through Islamic influence during the medieval period in Bengal.
note: This is more of a borrowed lexical item than a traditional idiomatic expression, but commonly used in idiomatic senses in Bengali.
